---
name: Biased output
about: A simulation run produced a stereotyped or unfair reading of a role or group
labels: bias
---

## Scenario or role
The scenario file in `configs/quests/` or the role description used in the rehearsal.

## Rollout draft
The announcement or plan text you rehearsed, stripped of anything confidential.

## Output received
The simulated response or diagnostic output that flattened the role into a stereotype.

## What it got wrong
In a sentence or two, what the output assumed about the role or group that did not fit the work.
